tagline: India's dedicated hiring platform for the hosiery and textile trade.

home.headline: Find skilled work in knitting, dyeing & garment units
home.sub: From machine operators to production supervisors — every role in the hosiery and textile industry, in one place.

home.industrySub: Browse openings across knitting, dyeing, cutting, stitching and dispatch floors.

home.howTitle: Three steps to your next role
home.how1Body: Register with your mobile number and OTP, then add your skills, experience and resume.
home.how2Body: Filter openings by trade, city and salary — every listing is verified before it goes live.
home.how3Body: Apply in one tap. Employers see your full profile and contact you directly.

home.employerSub: Post jobs for free during launch, and run attendance, salary, tasks and expenses from the connected Office Management dashboard.

home.employerPoint2: Attendance, salary and expense tracking built in
home.employerPoint3: Assign and monitor tasks for your team

about.title: Built for the hosiery and textile trade
about.intro: LoomHire connects knitting, dyeing, stitching and finishing units with the skilled workers they need — and gives every employer a simple dashboard to run their office once the hiring is done.
about.pillar1Body: No noise from unrelated industries. Every listing comes from a hosiery, knitting, dyeing, garment or export unit.
about.pillar2Body: The entire platform works in both languages, so workers can apply comfortably in the language they read best.
about.pillar3Body: Employers get attendance, salary, tasks, expenses and location tracking in a connected Office Management dashboard.
about.ctaSub: Registration is free for both workers and companies during our launch period.
